title: 第11章 薅第12章 召唤术
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
最后，法伦以一顿咖喱的代价，让千代帮忙借了一本《东帝国地理图志》，千代自己也借了一本书，但没告诉法伦是什么。
两人一同回到了宿舍，在宿舍三楼分别时，法伦告诉樱千代煮咖喱还需要一段时间，并约定一个小时之后在他的房间，也就是414号房见面。
樱千代点点头，拿着书转身走向她的房间。
法伦则继续沿着走廊前行，当走到妮可的房间门口时，他停下脚步，思考片刻后，轻轻敲了敲门。
“谁啊？”
门内传来妮可的声音。
“我，法伦。”
“怎么啦？要吃饭了吗？”
“今晚吃咖喱，樱千代也会过来，你要来吗？”
法伦问道。
“吃！”
妮可毫不犹豫地回答道。
“行，那你四十五分钟后过来吧。”
法伦说道。
“好嘞。”
法伦笑了笑，然后转身走回自己的房间。
本来以为妮可可能会顾虑千代的事情，今晚不会过来，但似乎她并不在意。
回到房间后，法伦将手中的书随意地放置于书桌上，系上一条蓝色的围裙，哼着小曲，准备开始烹饪晚餐。
看来是图书馆的惊魂一幕并没有给法伦带来任何负担，法伦的想法也很简单，反正没出事，还涨了学力值，以后的事以后再说，说不定根本活不到下次去图书馆的时候呢？
也不知道法伦这算是乐观还是悲观。

他的动作熟练而有序，明明只是第二天，却仿佛这已经成为了他日常生活中的一部分。
首先，法伦将早晨购买回来的食材一一取出：洋葱、胡萝卜和土豆。
他小心翼翼地削去它们的外皮，并将它们切成大小均匀的块状。
随着刀起刀落，厨房内响起了清脆的切菜声，宛如一首美妙的交响曲。
接着，法伦打开魔法炉灶，让火焰熊熊燃烧起来。
他熟练地倒油入锅，感受着油温的逐渐升高。
当锅中的油开始微微冒烟时，他迅速将切好的洋葱倒入锅内，用铲子轻轻翻炒。
顿时，厨房里弥漫起一股浓郁的洋葱香气，让人垂涎欲滴。
不久，洋葱变得金黄酥脆，散发出诱人的香气。
法伦连忙将事先准备好的咖喱粉倒入锅中，继续不停地搅拌。
咖喱粉与热油相互交融，散发出浓郁的咖喱味。
紧接着，法伦将切块的鸡肉、土豆和胡萝卜一同放入锅中，再加入适量的水。
他轻轻盖上锅盖，等待着咖喱的炖煮。
在这段时间里，法伦转身开始准备米饭。
content_en:
In the end, Fallon asked Chiyo to help borrow a book "Geographical Atlas of the Eastern Empire" at the cost of a meal of curry. Chiyo also borrowed a book himself, but did not tell Fallon what it was.
The two returned to the dormitory together. When they parted on the third floor of the dormitory, Fallon told Sakurachiyo that it would take some time to cook the curry and agreed to meet in his room, Room 414, in an hour.
Sakurachiyo nodded, turned around and walked towards her room with the book in hand.
Fallon continued walking along the corridor. When he reached the door of Nicole's room, he stopped, thought for a moment, and knocked lightly on the door.
"Who?"
Nicole's voice came from the door.
"I'm Fallon."
"What's wrong? Do you want to eat?"
"We're having curry tonight and Sakurachiyo will be coming too. Do you want to come?"
Fallon asked.
"Eat!"
Nicole answered without hesitation.
"Okay, then come over in forty-five minutes."
Fallon said.
"Okay."
Fallon smiled, then turned and walked back to his room.
I originally thought that Nicole might be worried about Chiyo and wouldn't come over tonight, but it seemed like she didn't care.
After returning to the room, Fallon placed the book in his hand casually on the desk, put on a blue apron, hummed a tune, and prepared to start cooking dinner.
It seems that the shocking scene in the library did not bring any burden to Fallon. Fallon's idea is also very simple. Anyway, nothing happened and his academic score has increased. We will talk about the future later. Maybe he won't survive the next time he goes to the library?
I don’t know if Fallon is optimistic or pessimistic.
His movements were skillful and orderly. Even though it was only the second day, it seemed as if this had become a part of his daily life.
First, Fallon took out the ingredients he bought in the morning: onions, carrots and potatoes.
He carefully peeled off their skins and cut them into evenly sized pieces.
As the knife rose and fell, the crisp sound of chopping vegetables sounded in the kitchen, like a beautiful symphony.
Fallon then turned on the magic stove and let the flames burn brightly.
He skillfully poured the oil into the pan, feeling the temperature of the oil gradually rise.
When the oil in the pot started to smoke slightly, he quickly poured the chopped onions into the pot and stir-fried them gently with a spatula.
Suddenly, a strong aroma of onions filled the kitchen, making people salivate.
Soon, the onions become golden and crispy, exuding an attractive aroma.
Fallon quickly poured the prepared curry powder into the pot and continued to stir.
The curry powder and hot oil blend together to create a rich curry flavor.
Immediately afterwards, Fallon put the diced chicken, potatoes and carrots into the pot, and then added an appropriate amount of water.
He gently covered the pot and waited for the curry to simmer.
During this time, Fallon turned back to preparing the rice.
